_note: Bramblewick voice manifest. Audio split from two ElevenLabs takes in this exact order. 'text' = what shows in the speech bubble (tags stripped). 'tts' = what was sent to ElevenLabs. 'pose' = sprite from the pose sheet. Portrait frames live in wizard/*.png, all the same size and position (stack them, never reposition).

intro.text: WHA— GERALD?! Gerald, you old toad! You came back!
intro.tts: [startled] WHA— GERALD?! [excited] Gerald, you old toad! You came back!

intro.text: …Hang on. You don't smell like mushrooms. You're not Gerald.
intro.tts: [pause] [suspicious] …Hang on. [sniffs] You don't smell like mushrooms. You're not Gerald.

intro.text: Gerald went out for mushrooms. Said he'd be back by supper. That was three hundred years ago.
intro.tts: [sighs] Gerald went out for mushrooms. Said he'd be back by supper. [pause] That was three hundred years ago.

intro.text: Forgive me. I don't get many visitors. Or any, really. I've been talking to my lantern. She's a terrible listener.
intro.tts: [clears throat] Forgive me. I don't get many visitors. Or any, really. I've been talking to my lantern. [whispers] She's a terrible listener.

intro.text: I am Bramblewick, keeper of the Seed Archive. And you are…?
intro.tts: I am Bramblewick, keeper of the Seed Archive. And you are…?

intro.text: Ah, {name}! A fine name. Much better than Gerald. Don't tell him I said that.
intro.tts: [warmly] Ah! A fine name. Much better than Gerald. [pause] Don't tell him I said that.
intro._note: Bubble shows the typed name; audio stays generic.

intro.text: Every world begins as a seed… a single number holding forests, oceans… and secrets buried deep.
intro.tts: [mysterious] Every world begins as a seed… a single number holding forests, oceans… and secrets buried deep.

intro.text: Most folk wander for hours searching for the right one. Fools. Gerald was one of them.
intro.tts: [chuckles] Most folk wander for hours searching for the right one. Fools. [pause] Gerald was one of them.

intro.text: But you've got me. Tell me what your heart wants to build, and I'll find the world that's been waiting for you.
intro.tts: [excited] But you've got me. Tell me what your heart wants to build, and I'll find the world that's been waiting for you.

idle.text: You lost too? Ha! Join the club. I've been lost since 1702.
idle.tts: You lost too? [laughs] Ha! Join the club. I've been lost since 1702.

idle.text: Still there? Gerald used to stare like that. Then he wandered off.
idle.tts: [curious] Still there? Gerald used to stare like that. [pause] Then he wandered off.

idle.text: Take your time. I've got… well, eternity, mostly.
idle.tts: [sighs] Take your time. I've got… [pause] well, eternity, mostly.

idle.text: Oh! Sorry. Thought you'd fallen asleep. Happens to me constantly.
idle.tts: [startled] Oh! Sorry. [chuckles] Thought you'd fallen asleep. Happens to me constantly.

idle.text: Psst… the jungle ones are the best. Don't tell the deserts.
idle.tts: [whispers] Psst… the jungle ones are the best. Don't tell the deserts.

textLines._note: Text-only lines (no audio). Shown as speech bubbles with the fake mouth flap while the text types out. {name} is replaced with the player name.

edition-ask.text: Tell me, Traveller, do you hail from the Java lands or the Bedrock isles?

version-ask.text: And which age of the world do you walk in?

quest-biome.text: Where shall you wake each morning?

quest-sea.text: Do you fancy the sea about you?

quest-end.text: And how near must the End's door be?

quest-cast.text: Stand back, {name}. This one's a big spell.

quest-unsure.text: I've hidden the spells I can't yet vouch for in the Bedrock isles. Better none than a wrong one.

search-found.text: Ha! There it is. Gerald would be green with envy.

search-none.text: Bah! Even I can't conjure that one. Shall we loosen the spell a little?

search-done.text: There. A shelf of worlds, all yours for the taking.

book-empty.text: Not a single world saved. Even Gerald kept a list.

talkRules.howTo: While a clip plays, switch between the two frames for that pose based on the audio loudness (Web Audio AnalyserNode, open when the level passes about 0.08). Other poses don't have a talking frame, so give them a gentle bob in time with the audio instead.
talkRules.idleMotion: Always running: 2px float up and down every 3s, and a blink every 4 to 6 seconds (a brief switch to 'smug' or 'sleepy' looks like a blink).
talkRules.fullBody: The 'fullBody' entries play a one-off full-body sprite moment (from the first pose sheet) before settling back into the portrait.
